# Spruce of Liability (`spruce-of-liability`)

Checks patient liability (Medicaid share of cost) and private-pay balances: liability not billed, billed short or over the current notice (prorated for partial months), unpaid balances by age, and credit balances to refund. Resident identifiers are masked before results reach the model.

**Spruce never sends statements or letters to residents or families. Spruce never issues refunds.**

Evergreen ver 1 · Billing and revenue cycle · MIT · Node 20 or newer · local files only · resident and staff identifiers masked before results reach the model · built on [`evergreen-core`](../evergreen-core)

```bash
npx -y spruce-of-liability demo
npx -y spruce-of-liability mcp --root ./facility-files
```

## What the sample data shows

Fictional Cedar Hollow residents, March 2026, payments counted to 2026-04-10. Planted: R602 a new liability notice from 1 March (1105) still billed at the old 980, R603 not billed for March, R604 paid twice its liability (credit balance), R605 discharged 16 March but billed the full month (prorated liability is 15/31), R606 private pay unpaid since February. R601 is clean.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does | Policy |
|---|---|---|
| `spruce_check` | Compare liability notices with resident billing for a month, and list unpaid and credit balances. | runs |
| `spruce_write_report` | Write spruce-liability.csv (one row per item, with blank owner and decision columns) and spruce-liability.html into out_dir (default evergreen-out/spruce). | runs |
| `spruce_recall` | Search this agent's own memory of the customer's setup: accepted facts (in use) and facts waiting for a person. | runs |
| `spruce_learn` | Propose one fact about the customer's setup for this agent to remember. | runs |
| `spruce_accept_learning` | A named person accepts or rejects a fact waiting in this agent's memory. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `spruce_retire_memory` | A named person stops an accepted fact from applying. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `statement_send` | Spruce never sends statements or letters to residents or families. | refused |
| `refund_issue` | Spruce never issues refunds. | refused |

Any tool name not in this table is blocked, including names a model invents. Refused tools are listed so a model can see they exist and are refused.

### `spruce_check` arguments

| Argument | What it is |
|---|---|
| `schedule` (required) | Liability notices under --root: resident, monthly amount, effective from and to |
| `billing` (required) | Resident billing under --root: resident, month (YYYY-MM), amount, kind (liability or private) |
| `payments` | Optional resident payments under --root: resident, date, amount |
| `census` | Optional census under --root, to prorate partial months |
| `rules` | Optional rules JSON: prorate, unpaid_days |
| `month` (required) | Billing month to check, YYYY-MM |
| `as_of` | Date payments are counted to (YYYY-MM-DD, default today) |
| `status` | Only items with this status |
| `limit` | Most items to return to the model (the report file always has all of them) |

## Columns it reads

Tables can be CSV, TSV, semicolon- or pipe-separated text, Excel `.xlsx`, JSON or JSONL. Columns are matched by the names below (any case and punctuation), and by their usual names in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Chinese and Korean. Dates become `YYYY-MM-DD`. Columns marked *masked* hold resident or staff identifiers.

The PointClickCare, MatrixCare and American HealthTech style names were written from public help pages and general knowledge, **not checked against real exports**. Run `npx spruce-of-liability inspect <file>` (column names and shapes only, never values) and name any column it misses in `remedy-sources.json`.

|---|---|---|
| `resident_id` | text (masked) | Resident ID, Resident #, Resident Number, Res ID, Res #, MRN, Medical Record Number, Client ID |

## Settings file (`spruce_rules`)

A small JSON file you pass by path. A misspelled setting is refused by name rather than ignored, so a typo never silently changes a check.

| Setting | What it does |
|---|---|
| `prorate` | Prorate the monthly liability for partial months in the building (default true; follow your state rule) |
| `unpaid_days` | Flag balances whose oldest unpaid bill is older than this (default 60) |

## Memory

`spruce_learn` only proposes a fact; nothing changes until a named person accepts it with `spruce_accept_learning`, which is one click even in Auto. Facts live in a hash-chained file under `.remedy/memory/`; if the chain does not verify, no fact is used. Credentials, personal identifiers and text that reads like instructions to an AI are refused.

| Kind | What an accepted fact does |
|---|---|
| `collection_note` | is shown with results. It never changes a check. |

## Install

Node 20 or newer. No other runtime dependencies besides `evergreen-core` and `remedy-core`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "spruce-of-liability": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "spruce-of-liability",
        "mcp",
        "--root",
        "/path/to/facility-files"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Claude Code: `claude mcp add spruce-of-liability -- npx -y spruce-of-liability mcp --root .`, or use the plugin files in this folder.

## CLI

```bash
spruce-of-liability tools                 # every tool, its policy and arguments
spruce-of-liability sources               # the columns each input is read from
spruce-of-liability inspect <file>        # how a file would be read (names and shapes, never values)
spruce-of-liability call spruce_check '{"schedule":"<schedule>","billing":"<billing>","month":"<month>"}'
spruce-of-liability eval                  # the private eval cases on the fictional fixtures
spruce-of-liability demo
```

## Resident and staff data

Results go to an AI model, so identifiers are masked before they leave the agent: resident and staff names become stable pseudonyms such as `PT-3f9a1c2e`, record and account numbers become `MRN-…` or `ACCT-…`, and e-mails and phone numbers are removed, also inside free text. Report files written to disk keep real names because staff work from them: keep them in a folder only your staff can open. The shared tests check that no fictional identifier from the fixtures reaches any eval result, and the hostile-input check plants spreadsheet formulas, HTML and AI-aimed instructions in the data. This keeps PHI away from the model; it is **not** a HIPAA compliance determination. Your business associate agreements, access controls and policies still apply.

## Limits

- Reads only the files you give it. It does not log in to PointClickCare, MatrixCare, a payer portal, a bank, a state Medicaid portal or a payroll system.
- Medicare, Medicaid and payroll rules are summarised from public material as of 2026 and the numbers are settings you supply; a billing, payroll or legal professional checks them before you rely on them.
- Not legal, tax, accounting, clinical, reimbursement or HIPAA advice. A person decides what to bill, pay, appeal, file or send.
- Every call is written to a hash-chained audit log under `.remedy/` in the root. No network calls, no telemetry, no credentials. The bundled data is fictional.
